title: Land Paper Ownership Verification Guide
problem: A farmer family near our house lost their savings buying a small land plot because the seller gave them fake, unregistered title papers.
idea: A simple land paper checklist. Before paying any money, the family ticks each check. If checks are missing, the page warns them to stop and verify.

widgets.heading: ✅ Try it: Before you buy land, check…
widgets.intro: Tick only what you have really checked yourself.

items.text: Seller's name matches the official land record online (Telangana land portal – Bhu Bharati, earlier Dharani)
items.te: అమ్మేవారి పేరు ప్రభుత్వ భూ రికార్డులో (భూ భారతి) ఉంది

items.text: Survey number and land size match the papers
Seller showed the original pattadar passbook and title deed
items.te: అమ్మేవారు అసలు పట్టాదార్ పాస్‌బుక్, దస్తావేజు చూపించారు

items.text: Encumbrance Certificate (EC) checked – no loan or case on the land
items.te: ఈసీ చూశాం – భూమిపై అప్పు, కేసు లేదు

items.text: Visited the MRO / Tahsildar office to confirm
Walked the land and talked to neighbours
Sale will be registered at the Sub-Registrar office

bands.text: Good checking! Still take a lawyer's advice before paying.
Some checks missing. Do NOT pay yet.
STOP! Too many checks missing. You may lose your money.

items.title: Hurry deals
items.text: 'Pay today or lose the deal' – a big warning sign.

items.title: Cash only
items.text: Pay through bank, never big cash amounts without registration.

items.title: Too cheap
items.text: Much cheaper than nearby land? Find out why.
items.te: చుట్టుపక్కల కంటే చాలా తక్కువ ధర అయితే కారణం తెలుసుకోండి.

questions.q: Where is land sale officially registered?
questions.why: Only a registered sale deed makes you the legal owner.

questions.q: What does an Encumbrance Certificate show?
options: If the land has loans or cases
questions.why: EC shows past transactions and loans on the land.

questions.q: Seller gives only photocopies and wants cash today.

how: Ask Gemini for the official steps to check land ownership in Telangana.
Visit the official land portal website with a parent to see how a land record looks.
Make a 7-point checklist with Gemini in English and Telugu.
Ask the MRO office staff or a teacher to check the steps.
Design an awareness guide in Canva with a big red 'STOP – Check first!' sign.
Put the guide at the Gram Panchayat notice board.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student in Telangana. Give a simple 7-step checklist in English and Telugu for a village family to verify land papers before buying: official land records portal, pattadar passbook, encumbrance certificate, MRO office, Sub-Registrar registration. Add 4 red flags of land fraud and advise talking to a lawyer.
